name: focus
description: One thing at a time, redone: frosted glass over Hiroshige's Zoshigaya, a warm ink-and-paper palette, and a New Tab page set like a title card: one question, what you are working on, a large session timer with presets, and today's sessions as a row of marks. The chat reads as messages, the sidebar is a rail whose bands hide until you point at it, and nothing moves.

files.themes/last-demo-focus.json:
// Focus: ink on warm paper, behind frosted glass. Hiroshige's Zoshigaya is there but quiet: the
// glass is frosted, not clear, so it reads as a mood and never as a picture to look at. One sage
// accent, soft amber for warnings, no borders, rounded but small corners.
{
  "name": "Focus",
  "description": "Ink on warm paper behind frosted glass over Hiroshige; one sage accent, no borders.",

  "appearance.theme": "Rose Pine Moon",
  "colors": {
    "background": "#1b1915",
    "foreground": "#ece4d4",
    "cursor": "#a8c6a0",
    "selection": "#38342b",
    "accent": "#a8c6a0",
    "1": "#e08a7a",
    "2": "#a8c6a0",
    "3": "#e2b872",
    "4": "#8fb3c9",
    "5": "#c4a6c9",
    "6": "#8cc2b8"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  "appearance.background": "hiroshige-zoshigaya",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.86,
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "frosted",

  "appearance.chromeStyle": "bare",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "oneColor",

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "same",
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",

  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#1b1915",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.92,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#1b1915",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.92,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#1b1915",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 0.6,

  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#a8c6a0",

  // Shape, not only color (Leo: "customizing the tabs/sidebars a lot deeper"): nothing in the way: a slim 220 pt sidebar, soft 8 pt rows, wide spacing, and the top right buttons and + only on hover.
  "density": { "basedOn": "spacious", "tokens": {"tabCornerRadius": 8, "verticalTabCornerRadius": 8, "sidebarCornerRadius": 8, "sidebarWidth": 220, "sidebarRowGap": 4, "tabGap": 8 } },
  "window.titlebarButtons": "hover",
  "tabs.plusButton": "hover",
  "agentPane.display.sessionInfo.placement": "overlay",
  "focus.inactiveTabStyle": "quiet"
}
